title: French Fries
description: Baked potatoes have been replaced with French fries.
body:
**French Fries Baked Potato**

A simple resource pack that replaces the Baked Potato item with French Fries.

**Features:**

- Replaces the Baked Potato texture with French Fries.
- Renames Baked Potato to French Fries.
- Custom pack icon.
- Lightweight and vanilla-friendly.
